cues: Arrange r objects, chosen from n different objects, in a row.
The first box can take any of the n.
The second, n minus one, because one is used.
And the r th box takes n minus r plus one.
text: Now the general case. Arrange r objects, chosen from n different objects, in a row. The first box can take any of the n. The second, n minus one, because one is used. The third, n minus two. And the r th box takes n minus r plus one.
